title: Operations Manager
description: About Syd Life AI We build life quality infrastructure that compounds validated research and action into better living . Syd , our companion , draws on 2.7 million+ peer-reviewed studies and 14.3 billion+ person-years of longitudinal data , and turns that evidence into action across nine dimensions of life quality . Every recommendation traces back to its evidence . Syd is available in 30 languages and deployed in 26 countries . Privacy and security sit at the centre of how we build : SOC 2 , ISO 27001 , ISO 42001 , GDPR and HIPAA . Our goal is to give people their agency back . We hire people who already act that way : you choose the problem , test the idea against the evidence and measure the impact . Small remote team , real ownership from your first week , consulting agreements with equity . The role Syd is looking for an Operations Manager , reporting to the CEO , to make sure every client delivery and company project is planned , tracked and delivered on time . You will set one consistent project management standard across the company and turn direction into plans , owners and dates . The path to Head of Operations is earned through delivery , with a review at 12 months . What you bring 3 to 4 years in strategy consulting , investment banking , or a tech start-up or technology company . A degree in a hard science : mathematics , physics , chemistry , engineering or computer science . Several projects delivered in parallel , to deadline , budget and quality . Daily , hands-on use of AI tools in your own work , including AI assistants , Jira and Google Workspace . Written English to board standard : answer first , short and structured . Integrity and conscientiousness : you keep your word , raise issues early with a plan to fix them , and check every detail . What you will do Plan , track and deliver every client project on time , each with a written plan , owner and date . Set and maintain one project management standard across client deliveries and internal projects . Track company projects and OKRs weekly , flag early when a date is at risk and set out a recovery plan . Prepare , run and follow up the monthly data rounds . Plan and organise the team off-sites . Run company operations with the CFO : contracts , suppliers , hiring logistics and onboarding . Terms Remote , open to candidates anywhere in the world , with working hours that overlap with the Gulf and Japan . Consulting agreement with equity . How to apply Apply at careers.syd.life/careers
